name: erpsc
description: ERPSC - Multi-tenant School Management SaaS (Node.js + React + React Native)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,app -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n api,web,app -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:lan" "npm --prefix mobile run start:lan"
